mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_outline WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_outline SET title=#{title},description=#{description},catalog_kind=#{catalogKind},subject=#{subject},textbook_version=#{textbookVersion},grade=#{grade},term=#{term},edition=#{edition},catalog_source=#{catalogSource},status=#{status},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_source_outline_scope WHERE outline_id=#{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_outline_scope WHERE outline_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_render_job j, JSON_TABLE(j.config_snapshot_json, '$.productCatalog.outlineScopes[*]' COLUMNS(outline_id BIGINT PATH '$.outlineId')) r WHERE r.outline_id=#{id})
